subject: Onboarding clearance: background intake, I-9 scheduling, and remote setup plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@starlighthealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Onboarding clearance: background intake, I-9 scheduling, and remote setup plan

Hi team,

Welcome aboard again, Alex — delighted you'll be joining us. Quick note to kick off the background and onboarding paperwork so we can hit the ground running on your first day.

Action items (owner in parens):
- Alex: please complete the attached background intake form and upload your ID for I-9 verification (attachment: background_intake_form.pdf) by EOD Thursday (Marissa).
- Ben: can you start the IT/email and laptop provisioning ticket once we have Alex's confirmation of start date (Ben).
- Soojin: I'll need the final start date to schedule the orientation and manager intro (Soojin).

A few logistics:
- Proposed start window: week of Nov 23 (we discussed remote-first).
- DocuSign bundle with the offer addendum and tax forms is being routed; I'll share the link when it's live.
- Background vendor: ClearCheck — they'll send an email with a verification link; candidate action is required to complete consent and upload docs.

Alex — if you have any scheduling conflicts for the I-9 (we can book a video verification slot) let us know.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Talent Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0187

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@starlighthealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-06T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding clearance: background intake, I-9 scheduling, and remote setup plan

Thanks, Marissa — appreciate the heads up.

I've filled out the intake form and attached the driver's license scan to the ClearCheck portal (I got their email at 09:45). My preferred start date is Monday, Nov 23. I also prefer the afternoon I-9 slot if one is available (I work mornings).

Let me know if you need anything else from me.

Best,
Alex
Alex Morgan
Senior ML Engineer (incoming)
alex.morgan@starlighthealth.com
+1 (617) 555-0102

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@starlighthealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T11:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding clearance: background intake, I-9 scheduling, and remote setup plan

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Alex. Nov 23 (Mon) is confirmed on our side pending ClearCheck completion.

Ben — can you please:
- Open the provisioning ticket (priority: standard new-hire) and allocate a MacBook Pro 14" with 32GB, a manager-approved VPN profile, and Slack SSO access. Tag it "Start-Nov23-AlexM".
- Coordinate with IT to schedule remote laptop delivery to Alex's address on 11/20 or 11/21 (whichever gets us time to image).

Marissa — when DocuSign is live, loop me so I can confirm manager sign-offs (IT will need the final username).

Alex — for orientation week, you'll have: manager 1:1 (Mon 10:00 PT), team sync (Tue 09:30 PT), and an intake with Security for data access (Wed 11:00 PT). I'll send calendar holds once Ben confirms.

On the I-9: we can do remote verification; I'll schedule an afternoon slot on Nov 23 at 2:30 PM PT if that works — if ClearCheck needs a different flow, I'll follow up.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@starlighthealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T13:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding clearance: background intake, I-9 scheduling, and remote setup plan

Acknowledged — opening ticket now.
Ticket summary: Provision laptop + accounts for Alex Morgan (Start Nov 23).
- Assigned: IT Imaging (ticket IT-5498)
- Requested hardware: MacBook Pro 14", 32GB, 1TB SSD
- Access: Slack (SAML), Okta account, VPN (manager profile), GitHub org invite
- Delivery: address captured from Marissa's intake (I'll DM for exact address)
- Imaging window: aim to ship 11/20; ETA 2 business days.

I'll add a calendar invite for the 11/23 2:30 PM I-9 verification with a video link; if ClearCheck provides a different verification URL we'll update.

Ben Carter
IT Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@starlighthealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-06T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding clearance: background intake, I-9 scheduling, and remote setup plan

Thanks, all — afternoon I-9 on the 23rd works for me. I'll watch for the DocuSign link and the ClearCheck confirmation.

Appreciate the fast coordination. Looking forward to joining the team.

— Alex
